top_signals.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level
top_signals.summary: Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Policy paper: Chancellor meeting with Gilt-edged Market Makers: Minutes - October 2026
top_signals.summary: Summary minutes of the Chancellor of the Exchequer’s meeting with the primary dealer firms in the gilt market, on 6 October 2026 in HM Treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
top_signals.summary: The new device shows Microsoft remains committed to making its own PCs even though it's not one of the top device makers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Grayscale says crypto ETF market is entering new phase as Zcash ETF tops $1 billion
top_signals.summary: Grayscale's Krista Lynch says SEC listing standards cover about 15 tokens, letting crypto ETF issuers get selective beyond bitcoin and ether.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Crypto trading giant GSR's new vault business is a $100M bet on onchain credit
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japanese firm confirms it sold books to Anthropic
top_signals.summary: Nippan IPS concluded a deal with Anthropic in November 2024 and sold books to it between December that year and last December.

top_signals.title: Arizona courts say hackers stole info on more than 1.3 million people
top_signals.summary: The investigation into the incident revealed cybercriminals were able to breach the Fines/Fees and Restitution Enforcement (FARE) Program, a statewide program that helps the court collect outstanding debts tied to traffic and criminal violations.
